findings: NIST AI Agent Standards Initiative continues to treat interoperability, agent security, identity and authorization as major standards/research pillars.
IETF draft-ietf-wimse-aims-01 (2026-11-02) proposes an AI Identity Management System using WIMSE/OAuth concepts; it is an active Internet-Draft, not consensus.
OpenAI documents MCP Apps as the shared UI standard: ui:// resources, ui/* JSON-RPC over postMessage, with optional ChatGPT extensions; this directly supports the canonical LIVE-001 architecture.
ARC-AGI-3 emphasizes interactive agentic intelligence and human learning efficiency, but remains a benchmark rather than a complete AGI definition.
research.decision: No change to IMA AGI v1.1. Current evidence strengthens identity/authorization/interoperability and interactive-agent evaluation dimensions but does not establish a stronger broadly accepted AGI consensus.
